app.name: Nakama Binder
app.tagline: Your One Piece Card Game collection

sets.title: Sets
sets.empty: No sets yet. Run the card import (see docs/SETUP.md).

account.title: Account
account.signedOutTitle: Sign in to build your binder
account.signedOutBody: Create a free account to track the cards you own and check your decklists — synced across all your devices.
account.comingSoon: Track your cards in the Collection tab. Deck checking is coming next.
account.about: Card data and images © Eiichiro Oda/Shueisha, Toei Animation, Bandai. This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Bandai.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.resetBody: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.waitingForLink: Open the reset link from your email on this device to continue.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.

config.missingBody: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY (see docs/SETUP.md), then restart the app.

collection.title: Collection
collection.signedOutBody: Create a free account to track every card you own — exact arts and languages included — synced across all your devices.
collection.emptyBody: Open a set and switch on “Tap to collect” to tick off the cards you own, use + on any card page, or import a list you already have.
collection.ownedAcross_one: You own {{count}} copy of this card ({{printings}} printing).
collection.ownedAcross_other: You own {{count}} copies of this card across {{printings}} printing(s).
collection.signInToTrack: Sign in to track which cards you own →
collection.collectModeHint: Tap a card to add a copy; tap − to remove one. Faded cards are ones you don’t own yet.
collection.nothingHere: No cards to show with this filter.

import.title: Import cards
import.intro: Paste a list or choose a CSV / text file. Each line needs a card number; quantity and language are optional.
import.examples:
4xOP01-016            (OPTCG Sim format)
2 OP01-025_p1 JP      (alt art, Japanese)
OP05-119 x3           (quantity after)
CSV with columns like: code, quantity, language
import.defaultLanguage: Language for lines that don’t say
import.defaultLanguageHint: Lines can override it with EN / JP.

modeHints.add: Add these copies to what you already own.
modeHints.set: Set each listed card to exactly this quantity (0 removes it). Cards not in the list stay as they are.
modeHints.replace_all: Your collection becomes exactly this list. Everything not in it will be removed.

import.empty: Paste a list or choose a file first.
import.nothingValid: No line in this list has a card number we recognise.
import.collectionAfter: Afterwards your collection will have {{copies}} cards in {{printings}} printings.
import.collectionNow: Your collection now has {{copies}} cards in {{printings}} printings.
import.unknownHint: These will be skipped. Check the number, the _p/_r suffix and the language (some cards exist only in Japanese).
import.replaceConfirmBody: Every card that is not in this list will be removed from your collection. Consider exporting a CSV backup first.
